title: Apply to sell on MarketLink
intro: Tell us about your stall and contact details. An admin will review your application before you can list products.

next.title: What happens after you send this
next.read: An admin reviews your application and photos.
next.panel: Once approved, a stall panel opens in your account.
next.setup: There you set markets, pickup times and products.

step1.title: Your stall
step1.stallNameHint: Customers see this on the map and on their orders.
step1.aboutPlaceholder: One or two sentences. Who grows it and where.
step1.fromAccount: From your account. Change it on the Account page.

step2.title: Photos of the plot
step2.intro: One wide shot and one close shot, taken in the last 30 days. No filters.
step2.addVideo: Add a video, up to 60 seconds
step2.videoHint: Optional. A slow walk along the beds speeds up approval.

banner.title: The admin only checks that the plot exists.
banner.text: MarketLink does not verify licences, food safety or organic claims.

step2.photoHint: At least one photo is required. JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to {{max}} MB each.

step3.title: Before you send
step3.true: The details and photos are mine and accurate
step3.trueHint: False photos lead to rejection or suspension.
step3.present: I will be at the stall during my pickup window
step3.pay: Customers pay me at the stall
step3.payHint: MarketLink has no online payment or delivery.

sent.title: Your application is with an admin
sent.intro: Nothing changes for you in the meantime. Keep shopping, and watch your notifications for the answer.

accepted.title: An admin reads it
accepted.note: Usually within a few market days

toast.fix: We marked what still needs your attention.
toast.sent: You will hear from an admin in your notifications.

loadError.title: Couldn't load your application status
loadError.text: Check your connection and try again.

errors.photo: Could not upload that photo. Please try again.
errors.video: Could not upload that video. Please try again.
errors.send: Could not send your application. Please try again.
errors.stallNameLong: Keep the stall name under {{max}} characters.
errors.contactPersonLong: Keep the contact person under {{max}} characters.
errors.photoRequired: Add at least one photo of the plot.
errors.uploadInProgress: Wait until the upload finishes, then send.
errors.photoType: Photos must be JPEG, PNG or WEBP.
errors.photoTooLarge: That photo is larger than {{max}} MB.
errors.videoType: The video must be MP4, WEBM or MOV.
errors.videoTooLarge: That video is larger than {{max}} MB.
errors.terms: Tick all three boxes before you send.

approved.title: Your stall is approved
approved.text: Your account can now set up a stall — markets, pickup windows and products — from the farmer panel.

rejected.title: Your application was not approved
rejected.text: Contact an admin from the feedback form if you think this is a mistake.

suspended.title: Your stall is suspended
suspended.text: You can still sign in, but your products stay hidden from customers until an admin lifts the suspension.

suspendedBanner.title: Selling is paused on this account.
suspendedBanner.text: Existing orders already placed still run their course; you just cannot take new ones for now.
